shortDescription: 小锞 XiaoKe - Open-source cross-platform AI Agent Desktop
longDescription: 小锞 (XiaoKe) is an open-source cross-platform AI agent desktop for Windows, macOS, and Linux. 小锞 is the main coordinator agent inside the app — with chat, memory, skills, MCP tools, browser automation, and pool-based multi-agent orchestration, all running locally against the LLM provider of your choice.
